if (pm.response.code === 200) { const cities = pm.response.json(); const cl = Array.isArray(cities) ? cities : (cities.data ?? []); if (cl.length > 0) pm.environment.set("cityId", cl[0].id); }

const countries = pm.response.json(); const cl2 = Array.isArray(countries) ? countries : (countries.data ?? countries.countries ?? []); pm.test("has Sudan", () => pm.expect(cl2.map((c) => c.code)).to.include("SD"));
